title: The Little Conqueror Executes a Daoist; Sun Quan Inherits the South-East
summary: Sun Ce has the Daoist Yu Ji executed for the crime of being more beloved than himself, and is haunted to death for it — starting at his own reflection, tearing open a healing arrow wound, dead at twenty-six.
He leaves the south-east to his eighteen-year-old brother with the clearest advice in the book: for matters of the field, ask Zhou Yu; for holding what we have, ask Zhang Zhao.
history: Sun Ce really did die at twenty-six of an assassin's arrow wound. The haunting is the novel's explanation for a death that was otherwise merely unlucky.

pins.note: Eighteen, and now responsible for all of it.
Executed, and does not stay dead.
